Name: LOAD_BALANCER_NEW_DRAW_DIST_SCALE_PARAM_ST
Description: Draw distance and shadow draw distance scales by load level, used by the load balancer. Below the start level the scale is Scale: Start; between the start and end levels it moves towards Scale: End; from the end level up it is Scale: End.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance: Start
Fields.Description: Load level at which the draw distance scale starts moving from Scale: Start towards Scale: End.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance: End
Fields.Description: Load level at which the draw distance scale reaches Scale: End.

Fields.Name: Scale: Start
Fields.Description: Draw distance multiplier below the start level.

Fields.Name: Scale: End
Fields.Description: Draw distance multiplier at the end level and above.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance: Start (Shadow)
Fields.Description: Load level at which the shadow draw distance scale starts moving from Scale: Start (Shadow) towards Scale: End (Shadow).

Fields.Name: Draw Distance: End (Shadow)
Fields.Description: Load level at which the shadow draw distance scale reaches Scale: End (Shadow).

Fields.Name: Scale: Start (Shadow)
Fields.Description: Shadow draw distance multiplier below the start level.

Fields.Name: Scale: End (Shadow)
Fields.Description: Shadow draw distance multiplier at the end level and above.
